fluxos — deterministic Java call graphs

Usage:
  fluxos <command> [options]
  fluxos help [trace|index]

Commands:
  trace  trace a method and render Mermaid, DOT, or JSON
  index  print the indexed Java types as JSON
  version  print the CLI version

Examples:
  fluxos trace com.example.Workflow.start ./project
  fluxos trace --format=dot com.example.Workflow.start ./project
  fluxos trace --format=json com.example.Workflow.start ./project

Use fluxos trace --help or fluxos index --help for options.
